medoids.segmented: 2026-08-06 on the 1250 ns/walker (6 walkers, 7.5 us aggregate) c(t)-reweighted panel-C surface F(total_helicity, q_core), exported by `article_data.py --export-seg-fes` from C_pmf2d_qcore_total.dat (std<=10 kJ/mol, >=5 visits mask; 3132 reliable bins, up from 2363 at 1000 ns)
medoids.medoid_definition: min mean heavy-atom RMSD frame among 15 Boltzmann-weighted representatives of the region
medoids.frame_source_caveat: IMPORTANT provenance mismatch: the FES is built from the full 1250 ns/walker colvar, but the structures are drawn from data/1Nhp6A_apo_large/replica_*/..._proc.xtc, which cover 0-1000 ns only (5001 frames, 200 ps, 1539 atoms, protein-only), and --t-max-ns 900 narrows the candidate pool further to 0-900 ns. So these are representative frames taken from the first 900 ns of a surface estimated over 1250 ns. This is acceptable because a medoid is a representative structure, not an estimator, and the 2D minimum did not move between 1000 and 1250 ns (panel A: q_core 0.998, n_IDR-core 8.2 at both lengths; panel C basin minimum helicity 39.75 -> 39.25 at q_core 0.9975, i.e. one grid cell). Extending the pool would require rebuilding _proc.xtc to 1250 ns.
medoids.note: Entry 1 is the folded basin -- the ONLY basin on this surface: the watershed at --barrier 5 (and at 2 and 3) returns exactly one. Entry 2 is a SHOULDER, NOT a metastable state, and must never be called one. At 1250 ns the raw watershed still resolves it as a local minimum at (helicity 32.75, q_core 0.8625), F = 9.53 kJ/mol above the folded minimum, but its saddle prominence is only 1.271 kJ/mol = 0.509 kBT while the surface's own cross-snapshot std there is 6.96 kJ/mol -- the prominence is ~5.5x below the error on the surface. Because --barrier 5 correctly merges it away, its representative is extracted with the explicit --shoulder window instead. Change vs 1000 ns: the shoulder got SHALLOWER, not sharper (prominence 1.525 -> 1.271 kJ/mol, 0.611 -> 0.509 kBT) while its population grew (watershed region 2.84 -> 4.83 %; same fixed CV window 2.09 -> 2.89 %). The extra 250 ns therefore did not resolve it into a state -- consistent with the rest of the apo 1250 ns gate, where the +250 ns bought no new q_core round-trips.
medoids.character: helix-2-only melting. Over the 15 representatives of each region: helix2 8.85+/-0.33 (folded) vs 4.94+/-1.80 (shoulder); helix1 9.16+/-0.44 vs 7.94+/-1.22; helix3 21.12+/-0.62 vs 20.36+/-1.85 -- H3 essentially intact. The two medoid structures differ by 0.505 nm CA RMSD over the H1-H3 core (plumed residues 27-91).
medoids.vs_1000ns_medoids: Both medoids moved, because the candidate pool and the basin core both changed. Basin: replica 0 t=280200.2 ps (helicity 39.6053, q_core 1.0000) -> replica 0 t=697999.8 ps (38.0549, 0.9674); the two structures differ by 0.697 nm heavy-atom RMSD overall but only 0.158 nm CA RMSD over the H1-H3 core -- the difference is entirely the disordered N-terminal IDR, so the folded basin representative is structurally equivalent. Shoulder: replica 3 t=307200.0 ps (34.6924, 0.8789) -> replica 4 t=555999.8 ps (32.2939, 0.8364); 0.786 nm heavy-atom / 0.505 nm core CA RMSD, i.e. genuinely a different conformer, as expected for a broad, weakly populated, partially melted region whose representative is not well defined. 1000 ns versions archived in analysis/backup_1Nhp6A_apo_large_1000ns/.
medoids.structural_pool: data/1Nhp6A_apo_large/replica_*/1Nhp6A_parambsc1_tip3p_ions0.15_meta_2D_r*_proc.xtc (protein-only, 0-1000 ns, 200 ps, 5001 frames, 1539 atoms); candidates capped at 900 ns by --t-max-ns, ~10,554 on-grid candidate rows per walker, all 6 walkers pooled

representatives.sampling: frames drawn without replacement with probability proportional to exp(-(F-Fmin)/kBT) within the region core {F < Fmin + 3 kJ/mol}, on the c(t)-reweighted panel-C surface

medoids.q_bh_note: q_bh = canonical Best-Hummer Q evaluated on the medoid STRUCTURE (heavy, 0.45 nm, lambda=1.8), matching the Q_BH PMF panels; agrees with the per-frame cache to 4 dp. Coordinates only -- the basin/shoulder segmentation is still the q_core one. Source of truth is the q_bh column of C_medoids_cvs.dat.
